title: Tidal inlet at blue hour
subject: A quiet river estuary at blue hour, two small dark wooden boats, low reed island, distant weathered pale mill, a thin apricot sunset beneath a wide smoky blue sky. Landscape composition with asymmetrical shoreline.

title: The reader in sage
subject: An intimate fictional 1930s portrait of an older woman with short silver hair and a russet cardigan over a sage dress, holding a closed book, kindly thoughtful expression, dusky teal room background. Chest-up three-quarter view. Clearly an oil portrait, not a photograph.
frame: Ebonized step frame, muted gold inner bead

title: White horse in the meadow
subject: A small pale horse standing beside an old fence in a green spring meadow, distant willows and pale overcast sky. Soft grassy brush strokes and one rusty red gate. Intimate countryside vignette, almost square landscape.
frame: Honey oak bevel with broad flax mount

title: Footbridge after the rain
subject: An old narrow stone footbridge over a soft green stream, poplar trees and rust-colored autumn leaves, distant farmhouse just visible. Warm ochre highlights with muted olive shadows, rich confident oil brushwork, no figures.
frame: Mahogany scoop, brass bead and small corner rosettes

title: Courtyard laundry
subject: A charming old brick apartment courtyard, laundry on a line between windows, terracotta pots and a small bicycle leaning in shadow. Muted dusty rose brick, sage shutters, pearl white linen. Unhurried impressionist architecture study.
frame: Umber stepped rail, blue-grey inner slip

title: The orchard gate
subject: A generous old oil landscape of a weathered timber gate opening into a pear orchard with a winding footpath, distant hills and small cream cottage. A graceful dark tree frames the left, luminous warm afternoon clouds fill the upper third, olive green and amber foliage, russet earth and subtle dusty blue distances. The primary hall focal painting for a beloved old apartment. Elegant readable composition, visible confident painterly strokes.
frame: Broad aged gilt ogee with walnut outer edge and leaf corners

title: Swallows and hawthorn
subject: A vintage hand-colored naturalist plate of two small swallows on a hawthorn branch, berry-red accents, blue-black wings and pale cream paper. Elegant loosely painted watercolor with delicate ink edges, generous empty paper. No labels or writing.
frame: Ebony half-round with ivory mount and pencil fillet

title: Boats at low tide
subject: Three old fishing dinghies resting on pale sand at low tide, turquoise-gray shallows, distant harbor sheds, wide low horizon and milky clouded sky. Weathered red, ochre and pale blue boat hulls, vigorous but gentle oil brushwork.
frame: Weathered teal scotia with bleached wood slip

title: Rose stems and a bee
subject: A faded botanical watercolor of three old garden roses, one pink, one ivory, one dusky apricot, with visible stems and muted green leaves, a tiny bee at one blossom. Warm unruled cream paper background. Restrained antique naturalist charm, no writing.
frame: Ivory bead-and-reel, thin rosewood inner edge

title: Unfurling woodland fern
subject: An antique watercolor study of a woodland fern with three fronds in different stages of unfurling, warm olive and sage, fine copper-brown stems, on softly aged ivory paper. Asymmetrical near-square composition, delicate painterly botanical illustration. No text.
frame: Pale oak flat frame, double ivory/sage mount

title: Anemones in the blue jug
subject: A small oil still life of white and dusky pink anemones in a blue ceramic jug on a worn dark wooden table, a single fallen petal. Warm dusty mauve background and sage shadows, broad tactile strokes and softly simplified forms.
frame: Oxblood convex lacquer and fine gold fillet

title: Magnolia at dusk
subject: A horizontal decorative oil study of an ivory magnolia branch against a muted smoky mauve evening sky, a small pale moon in one corner, dusty blue distant garden shadows. Poetic but natural, broad soft strokes. Main blossoms placed centrally with clear breathing room for oval framing.
frame: Oval walnut bolection with cream oval liner

title: Hillside farm in spring
subject: A small watercolor landscape of a stone farmhouse on a sloping hillside, patchwork fields, leafing hedgerows and a cloud-shadowed blue gray sky. Earthy green and pale straw yellow, quiet rural character, loose transparent pigment edges.
frame: Dark oak sloping rail with warm paper mount

title: Woodland mushroom study
subject: A vintage watercolor naturalist plate with three distinct woodland mushrooms, russet-brown caps and pale gills, a sprig of moss and an oak leaf, arranged thoughtfully on warm cream paper. Soft illustrated strokes, interesting silhouettes, square composition, no labels or text.
frame: Slim antique brass double-round, terracotta mount edge

title: Moths in the fern garden
subject: A delicate antique naturalist painting of one large pale moth and two small brown moths arranged among slender fern leaves on warm ivory paper. Sage, dusty brown and cream wings, handpainted fine markings. Vertical composition, no labels, no text.
frame: Olive fluted wood with natural oak edge

title: Lavender and sage
subject: An intimate vintage watercolor botanical of a little tied bundle of lavender and sage, dusty violet blossoms and soft sage-green leaves, pale cream paper with gentle warmth. Vertical composition and generous margin, no writing, no labels.
frame: Chalk cream beaded pine with blue-grey mount

title: Pears by the coffee pot
subject: A warm antique oil still life: three green-gold pears, a small worn copper coffee pot, blue-and-white ceramic cup and folded cream linen on a dark kitchen table. Muted terracotta background, ochre glints and broad lively brush strokes. Humble and inviting, landscape composition.
frame: Dark farmhouse walnut, chamfered edge and brass corner pins
